2026-11-15.title: 20 km | Ultra pace
2026-11-15.detail:
Ultra pace (preferably on trails - walk the hills)
This is a pace to aim for during long runs when training for your ultra. This pace is will seem slow as it basically takes into account the fact that you will be both running and walking. It's essentially a 'keep moving' pace and is more aimed at stopping you going too fast than anything else.

2026-11-25.title: Core Stability
2026-11-25.detail:
CLICK ON VIDEO TAB FOR DEMONSTRATION OF MOVEMENT.
•Warm-Up:
• Shoulder Taps – 2 x 20 (10 per side)
• Reverse Lunge with Knee Drive – 2 x 10 per leg
•Main Set:
1. Bird Dog – 3 x 10 per side
2. Side Plank with Hip Drops – 3 x 10 per side
3. Dead Bug – 3 x 12
4. Cobra Hold – 3 x 15-second hold
•Cool-Down:
• Couch Stretch – 2 x Hold 20 seconds per side
• Foam Rolling Back Extension – 60 seconds
